workflow_runs.name: Sidebar R21 integrated UI quality
workflow_runs.display_title: Keep the visible Cloud tab reachable for Sidebar acceptance

head_commit.message:
Keep the visible Cloud tab reachable for Sidebar acceptance

Use the existing Cloud pane in the sole navigation and tab-memory path so its disclosures can be reached by click and keyboard. Preserve dirty-tool veto and the original task Stop owner.

Constraint: R32 explicitly requires the existing Cloud tab; the prior R14 redirect no longer applies.
Rejected: Another Cloud host or permission path | the existing pane and host already provide the capability.
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Directive: Cloud navigation must retain tool leave veto and exact RunHost Stop ownership.
Tested: 91 navigation/cloud tests, 214 affected integration tests, 668-file source check, independent seven-file review, partial real Chrome Cloud click.
Not-tested: Complete native width/zoom matrix and 95+ product acceptance.

workflow_runs.display_title: Keep Focus build proof current after parallel main changes

head_commit.message:
Keep Focus build proof current after parallel main changes

Preserve the separate latest main build receipts and the original native candidate. Record the successful current CI source job without elevating its queued native job.

Constraint: Shared main product inputs changed after the previous build
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Tested: 62 component tests; check; production and development builds; verify on main 197746aa; 470 input hashes and archived evidence hashes
Not-tested: Candidate-08 native quota and DNR; permission revocation and cross-tool isolation
